Updates a forwarding profile
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/webForwardingProfile/edit

Updates a forwarding profile.

string

Indicates if Skip Trusted Criteria match for VPN Adapters is enabled.

The DHCP server of the trusted network.

The egress IP address of the network.

The IDs of trusted networks.

string[]

The subnet of the trusted network.
